title.narrative: Cities and Climate in Africa (CICLIA) Project in Sub-Saharan Africa

description.narrative: The CICLIA project supports selected Sub-Saharan cities in transforming local climate strategies into action plans, budgets, and urban investment projects with climate co-benefits on both mitigation and adaptation aspects. It will do so by supporting city climate planning when needed, preparing low-carbon and resilient urban infrastructure projects and providing technical assistance before project implementation to municipal staff.
